title: NavigationRouteEdgeBatchRequest
description: Bounded route planning replays complete jobs from one captured search-start epoch. Required direct evaluation failures fail the batch.

characterId.description: Deprecated in Phase 3; ownership is established from the authenticated player and ship.

candidateBodyIds.description: Optional explicit pool. Omitted on bootstrap, the server discovers an approved bounded pool of up to ten Sol planets/moons; omitted on continuation, the captured pool is reused. Explicit continuation pools must match it as a set.

navigationMode.description: Omit for legacy behavior. ship-drive-normal applies the owned ship captured driveProfile.rangeAu to each exact leg independently; it has no inferred total drive range and retains the selected planner profile. bounded-preview-100au ignores ship drive range for planning only, requires stellar-sol-station-100au-v1, retains the 100 AU and six-leg/five-encounter bounds, and is not flight authorization. Nova must start a new bootstrap when navigationMode/profile/ship/destination changes; continuation is invalid across those changes.

profileId.description: Omitting profileId preserves legacy 0.5 AU leg/3 AU eligible-path behavior. Nova must explicitly send stellar-sol-station-100au-v1 for the temporary 100 AU total-route testing profile.

planningRevision.description: Required for continuation. Echoed by bootstrap; pins departure, source revisions and clock generation for the search.

bootstrapId.description: Opaque read-only continuity identifier. Bootstrap omits it; continuation supplies it with planningRevision.

timeoutMs.description: Optional budget hint; it does not guarantee a server deadline. A timeout is reported only if actually enforced and observed.
